findings.issue: Node-server adapter discovery took ~8 turns of dead-end probes (non-TTY `qwik add`, unproductive `npm pack create-qwik`, repeated node_modules greps)
findings.suggestion: Search the installed package's starters directory (`@builder.io/qwik/dist/starters/adapters/*`) first, or fetch the deployment docs, before probing CLI wizards that require a TTY

findings.issue: First pagination fix relied on an unverified assumption about `preventdefault:click` semantics ('skip SPA nav, allow native'), which silently broke navigation and cost a build+test cycle
findings.suggestion: When overriding framework link interception, verify the attribute's behavior against the framework source or write the explicit onClick$ + history handler from the start

findings.issue: `qwik build` was run without checking that the copied starter's `lint` script needs an eslint config that wasn't copied, failing the first build
findings.suggestion: When copying a starter's package.json piecemeal, copy its full script/config set or audit scripts before the first build

findings.issue: Attempted a Python PIL crop without confirming the module is installed; also no web search, MCP or skill usage at any point despite uncertainty about Qwik City APIs
findings.suggestion: Check tool availability before use; use the available framework docs/web search for API semantics questions instead of reverse-engineering lib/*.mjs

summary: A disciplined, near-linear session: it read the spec, tests and reference screenshots before coding, chose a correct SSR architecture first time, and wrote the whole app in one pass that landed 51/54 on the first test run. Failures were debugged from evidence — including reading Qwik City source to confirm the select/pagination behaviors — and verification went well beyond the suite, with screenshot comparison against the design references, a prerendered-data audit, and a fresh full test run after the final edit. The only real waste was a wandering adapter-scaffolding stretch and one wrong pagination guess, costing roughly 8 turns.
